description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing report mailing jobs in the Apache Fineract platform. It provides endpoints to create, update, delete, retrieve individual report mailing jobs, list all jobs, and retrieve a template for report mailing job details. The class uses JAX-RS annotations for REST mappings, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and integrates with Fineract's command and service layers for processing operations.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class for managing report mailing jobs, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and listing operations.

methods.name: createReportMailingJob
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new report mailing job with the provided JSON request body.

methods.name: updateReportMailingJob
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing report mailing job identified by entityId.

methods.name: deleteReportMailingJob
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove a report mailing job identified by entityId.

methods.name: retrieveReportMailingJob
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve details of a specific report mailing job by entityId, with optional template data.

methods.name: retrieveReportMailingJobTemplate
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a template for report mailing job details, used for building UI forms.

methods.name: retrieveAllReportMailingJobs
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list all report mailing jobs with optional filtering, pagination, and sorting.
